title: Confidence-Bounded Physical Feasibility Ranking (CB-PFR)
description: Draft deposit metadata for CB-PFR version 0.3.0, an untagged research-software development snapshot. Do not treat this file as evidence of an existing Zenodo record or DOI. Intended contents are the CB-PFR implementation, abstract QUBO model, frozen synthetic benchmark configuration and trial-level results, reproducibility/audit scripts, and explicit documentation of the unresolved physical-validation boundary.
